works.body:
COCシナリオ、ことほぎのいわいのHO祝いの全身立ち絵をお願いしてもよろしいでしょうか…？

https://booth.pm/ja/items/2955959

名前：祝部 瞬(ﾎｵﾘ ﾏﾄﾞｶ)
17歳男子。制服は学ランです。
APP9、SIZ9です。
HO呪い(彼女)から貰ったヘアピンを常につけていて、困ったことがあるとヘアピンに触る癖があります。
HO呪いと過ごす時間以外充実感を感じる事は少なく、HO呪い以外に対しては割と無表情です。逆に一緒にいる時はそれだけでご機嫌になります。
(にこにこな顔か無表情かはお任せします…！)
その為、APPの低さは顔に傷というより印象(ガラ)の悪さ、近寄りがたさ方面の予定です。
特徴表：寄せ餌 を持っています。

見た目の指定は、学ランとヘアピンのみで大丈夫です、
相方ちゃんが黒髪(ロング)に赤目な為、その子の彼氏っぽい色合いだったら嬉しいかな、という程度になります。

長々とすみません、もしも気が向きましたら多少でも課金の足しにしてくださったら嬉しいです。(*´ `)

It’s nice to meet you! 

My apologies for not being able to write in Japanese , I hope that my request will be translated properly. 

I hope you can take a look at my request whenever you get the chance. 

I wished for you to draw my original character. 

If it’s possible, I wish for a full body illustration to be drawn (or a knee up illustration would be satisfactory) 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

For the character setting 

Name : Luca 
Gender : Male 
Height : 175 cm 
Age : 18
Image color : dark blue 

My character finds it difficult to express himself so he rarely smiles. Despite being raised as a child soldier, there is an odd gap in character with him being both ruthless and cold yet gentle and sincere. 

He’s very good at fighting and using dual blades to fight. 

His appearance is very beautiful, his looks can be compared to that of a doll’s. He has very long eyelashes. 

I don’t have a specific background in mind so I hope you can draw something that suits my character.

I hope that you can draw my character in an intense and dynamic fighting pose and for the character’s appearance to be a bit injured (some parts of his clothes is torn and ripped and some parts of his skin has been cut and injured…the color of his blood is gold) 

I would love to see sparks of blue fire and flames around the character
